headline: Warren Buffett Hands Over Berkshire Helm After 59 Years
meta_description: At 96, the legendary investor passes chairman role to son Howard, completing a planned leadership transition at the $1.1 trillion conglomerate.
summary_short: Warren Buffett, 96, has stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after nearly six decades, handing the role to his son Howard.
body:
At 96 years old, Warren Buffett has completed his long-planned exit from the top leadership role at Berkshire Hathaway, passing the chairman position to his son Howard and moving into an advisory role as chairman emeritus. The transition marks the final chapter of a carefully orchestrated handover at the $1.1 trillion global conglomerate, which Buffett transformed from a struggling New England textile mill into one of the world's most successful investment vehicles since taking control in 1965. While Greg Abel, who took over as chief executive nine months earlier, will continue managing corporate strategy and capital decisions, Howard Buffett—a director since 1993—now guards the company's culture and values as chairman.

Buffett, known as the Oracle of Omaha, built his legendary reputation through decades of value investing and candid annual shareholder letters that turned him into a mentor across the financial world. His company today owns recognizable brands including GEICO insurance, Dairy Queen, and the BNSF railway, alongside substantial stakes in Apple and Coca-Cola—a drink the investor famously consumes five cans of daily. In his farewell letter, Buffett noted that the timing felt right after celebrating his 96th birthday alongside the first birthday of a great-grandchild "moving a bit faster" than he is, adding that it has been "the privilege of a lifetime" to serve as chairman while acknowledging that "Father Time always wins."

The transition represents an orderly passing of the baton rather than a sudden leadership crisis. Howard Buffett brings over three decades of board experience to his new role, having worked as a farmer, philanthropist, and sheriff. The company assured investors that operations will remain steady, with the entire leadership structure—from Abel's strategic decisions to Howard's cultural stewardship—designed to preserve the institution Buffett spent nearly six decades building.
quick_facts: Buffett, 96, stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman after 59 years
Son Howard Buffett takes over chairman role; Greg Abel remains CEO
Berkshire Hathaway is a $1.1 trillion global conglomerate
Company owns GEICO, Dairy Queen, BNSF railway, and Apple and Coca-Cola stakes
Buffett moves to chairman emeritus role, will advise the board
